text:
infra-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall (alice-sre). GPU pool us-west-2 saturated. Inference queue depth spiked to ~12.3k across the region, many requests are being throttled. Autoscaler attempted to add nodes but HPA shows no metrics for the gpu-inference deployment. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/gpu-exhaustion
alice-sre: taking this. Acknowledged. Starting live mitigation now. Can someone grab metrics-adapter logs and metrics-server pods? I'll try a manual scale and route traffic away from us-west-2 if possible.
ben-sre: looking. Prometheus Adapter is logging lots of errors to stdout: 
```
W prometheus_adapter.go:112 unable to retrieve external metrics: 503 Service Unavailable
error: client timeout waiting for Prometheus response
```
Also seeing scrape backlog > 10m on prometheus-sidecar, and adapter has queue growth.
alice-sre: ok doing manual scale of the inference deployment to buy time. Running:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/gpu-inference --replicas=8
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep gpu-inference
```
ops-bot: Note: account quotas for us-west-2 limit burst GPUs to 10 per AZ until finance approves. Manual scaling will respect limits.
alice-sre: thanks. Scaling succeeded to 8 replicas, but HPA still shows 0 desired because metrics endpoint dead. Posting status: /status create "Partial outage: inference latency elevated in us-west-2; mitigation in progress". Notifying support and CS.
dave-sales: customers A and C reported high latency and 504s starting ~06:12 UTC. We escalated with them. Carla, may need a customer update.
carla-pm: please publish an incident note to affected customers with ETA for resolution. Prioritize enterprise tenants on Dedicated.
ben-sre: digging into prometheus-adapter: adapter is failing with Quickstart auth errors when scraping the adapter config. Logs show repeated "error: emergency backoff: upstream busy". I can try a restart of the adapter and the prometheus-scraper sidecar.
alice-sre: go for the restart, but do a rolling restart, one replica at a time. Command I used to restart adapter pod: 
```
kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deployment/prometheus-adapter
kubectl -n monitoring rollout status deployment/prometheus-adapter --watch
```
ben-sre: restarted adapter replica 1 -> healthy, replica 2 -> healthy. After restart, adapter shows fewer 503s but still some latency. Checking metrics-server: several metrics-server pods are in CrashLoopBackOff; events show OOMKilled. Might need to increase memory limit.
alice-sre: what's current HPA output? `kubectl -n inference get hpa gpu-inference -o wide` returns:
```
NAME          REFERENCE               TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS   AGE
gpu-inference Deployment/gpu-inference   0/100     2         20        8          12m
```
Means HPA has no external metrics and is holding at manual replica count. Queue is still high but dropping from 12.3k -> 7.8k after manual scale.
ops-bot: also flag: control-plane autoscaler observed spot capacity shortage in us-west-2-a; provider limited new allocations for 15m. That contributed to failed automated scale.
alice-sre: given metrics-server OOMKills, I'm increasing metrics-server memory to 1Gi. Applying patch now:
```
kubectl -n kube-system patch deployment metrics-server --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"metrics-server","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"1Gi"},"requests":{"memory":"512Mi"}}}]}}}}'
```
ben-sre: after patch rollout, metrics-server pods came back up. Prometheus scrape lag reduced. Prometheus-adapter now reporting external metrics again. HPA observed metrics: queue_length=6000, target per-pod=1000 -> desired 6-7 pods.
alice-sre: HPA now scaled gpu-inference to 12 replicas automatically. Observed queue reduced to ~2.1k over next 5m. Running evict of oldest queued jobs for low-priority tenant to reduce pressure:
```
# admin-only eviction
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://control-plane.internal/queues/evict?tenant=low-priority&count=4000
```
carla-pm: thanks. We're drafting customer note: initial impact window 06:10-06:40 UTC. Notifying Dedicated customers and posting to status page.
dave-sales: two major enterprise clients reported degraded throughput but no data loss. They appreciate the update.
pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by incident manager. Severity updated to Sev2. All on-call teams paged/looped in.
alice-sre: current status: queue length steady ~2k, latency improving. GPUs in us-west-2 at ~85% utilization. Autoscaler observed metrics and no further errors in Prometheus Adapter. Manual scale rollback to target minimum initiated once stable.
ben-sre: root cause hypothesis: Prometheus scrape backlog + metrics-server OOMKilled caused metrics adapter to return 503s, HPA lost visibility -> autoscaler did not trigger. Secondary: spot capacity shortage slowed Dedicated pool scale-up.
alice-sre: mitigation summary: 1) manual scale to 8 -> 12 replicas; 2) restarted prometheus-adapter; 3) increased metrics-server memory; 4) evicted low-priority queue entries; 5) rerouted some traffic away from us-west-2.
alice-sre: follow-ups/owners: 
- Ben (ben-sre): postmortem + fix prometheus-adapter robustness (retries/backpressure handling). 
- Infra team: evaluate quota/reservation to avoid spot limits for critical pools. 
- Platform: add canary alerts for metrics-adapter error rate so HPA has early warning. 
- CS/PM: customer communications and timeline (carla-pm).
alice-sre: leaving a note for the oncall rotation: handoff to next oncall in 30m with summary. Will attach monitoring graphs and commands used to this thread.
ops-bot: incident log entry created id=INC-2026-3234, linked to pagerduty.
alice-sre: closing the live mitigation. If queue growth recurs, page SRE again. Postmortem owner Ben. :white_check_mark:
